algorithm.title: Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder: Diagnosis and Treatment.

cell.label: Patient with signs/symptoms of PMS/PMDD. Perform history and physical examination. Have patient perform symptom assessment for 2 cycles.
Suspected underlying medical or psychology condition.
Evaluation as indicated (CBC, TSH, hormone levels, screening for psychiatric disorders).
Patient education lifestyle modification, CAM treatment. Improvement?
Lifestyle modification, CAM treatment, consider luteal-phase (cyclic) SSRI. Improvement?
Treat symptoms individually (eg, anxiety with benzodiazepine); consider ovulatory suppression with drospirenone OC or GnRH agonist; consider TAH/BSO as last resort.

footnotes.footnote: Abbreviations: PMDD, premenstrual dysphoric disorder; PMS, premenstrual syndrome; CAM, complementary/alternative medicine; SSRI, selective serotonin receptor inhibitor; OCP, oral contraceptive pill; GnRH, gonadotropin releasing hormone; TAH/BSO, total abdominal hysterectomy/bilateral oophorectomy.
